title: Adamed — communication for the "Głęboki Oddech" program that educates on lung health and engages patients
excerpt: Running the "Głęboki Oddech Adamed" profile since April 2025 — +269% content interactions, +719% link clicks, and 2.6M views on educational content about respiratory health.
clientAbout: Adamed is a Polish pharmaceutical and medical company, and "Głęboki Oddech Adamed" is the educational program it runs to support people living with respiratory disease. Drawing on expert knowledge, it helps patients better understand their condition and improve their quality of life, offering reliable content along with practical tips and solutions.

The program takes a holistic approach to health, combining prevention, education, and everyday care for the patient. On social media that means content that builds awareness — from lung disease prevention to the importance of quitting smoking to daily life with asthma.

challenge.intro: Social Lama's brief was to run social media for the "Głęboki Oddech Adamed" program in a way that educates audiences on the benefits of looking after their own health.
objectives: Communication that underlines the importance of quitting smoking as a key step in caring for lung health.
Encouraging people to see their doctor regularly and keep track of their own health.
Creating content that motivates people to keep their asthma consistently under control and follow their specialists' recommendations.

pillars.heading: Reels with specialists
body: We built "Reels with specialists" as a series of engaging videos featuring doctors and respiratory disease experts. In plain language they explain how smoking affects the body — and, in a second run of the series, how to handle everything that comes with asthma.

We focused on educational, prevention-minded content that helps audiences understand how the disease works, why diagnosis and regular testing matter, and what role daily habits play in keeping the respiratory system healthy. Expert-led material builds awareness and motivates people to take care of themselves.

pillars.heading: Insight into what audiences really need
body: One of the things we did was start putting questions to the audience, so we could better understand their needs and their expectations around health topics.

That gave us direct insight into what patients actually need, which let us create content that was even better tailored and more valuable to the profile's community — from the differences between allergic and non-allergic asthma to coping with asthma attacks.

pillars.heading: Motivation to change
body: A key part of our communication is posts built around bold taglines meant to stay with people and get them thinking about their own health. Every post carries a simple but strong message that pushes people to act and change their habits.
At the same time, we want the captions to stay approachable and to encourage people, with empathy, to look after their lungs, get regular check-ups, and take a conscious approach to prevention.
